symptom: README QR image replacement selects every validation surface.
direct_cause: Any non-infrastructure deletion returns FULL_POLICY before path risk is considered.
class_root: Structural uncertainty was inferred from Git status without first proving the complete diff contains only documentation paths.
affected_population: All worktrees and CI events deleting documentation or marketing assets
entry_points: Main push and merge_group profile selection
internal_only_reason: This changes the internal Nomi risk policy; the existing Git name-status parser and protocol are unchanged.
invariants: Only a wholly documentation-safe A/M/D diff may bypass deletion fail-closed; mixed production, tests, CI and unknown paths retain existing policy.
Renames, empty diffs and release requests retain fail-closed semantics.
generality_proof: The sole classifier checks every normalized entry before applying a docs-only exemption, so mixed changes cannot inherit the safe path result from one entry.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own risk classification for all caller and event types.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Passes parsed Git entries and event name into classifyValidationPolicy.
PR, push and merge_group provide their base/head to the same profile script; lane conditions consume its outputs.

recurrence.reason: Every future documentation deletion reaches the same status-first rule.
same_class_scan: rg classifyValidationPolicy scripts: one production owner and select-quality-gate-profile consumer.
Inspected quality-gate.yml scope base SHA selection and all lane conditions including required-check aggregate.

prevention.invariant: The entire diff must be documentation-safe before deletion is exempted.
prevention.failure_mode: Mixed or unrecognized paths retain the existing fail-closed or risk-specific behavior.
prevention.strategy: Classify the complete normalized path/status set in the existing shared owner, before applying structural uncertainty.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed unconditional deletion escalation for proven docs-only diffs in place; no parallel classifier.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Pure internal path/status classification uses no third-party runtime.

migration: No stored state or public output fields change. docs_only is an explanatory reason on existing focused policy.
residual_risks: Historical QR commit fb79d8ac94dddb350fef69ed5627868d2140e726 also changed tests/ux/marketing-home.static.mjs; its full diff intentionally remains full. Only its documented four-entry documentation subset demonstrates docs-only.
